title: Activate default EPS bearer context reject

entities.name: Activate default EPS bearer context procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a default EPS bearer context between UE and network.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to reject the activation of a default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer for which activation is being rejected.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Contains protocol configuration options relevant to the bearer context activation.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for rejecting the default EPS bearer context activation.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message when activation is rejected.
The message contains the EPS bearer identity IE to identify the bearer being rejected.
The message includes protocol configuration options IE.
The message contains the EMM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.
